literal: On guichou day he visited Huaishuo garrison.
idiomatic: On guichou day he visited Huaishuo garrison.

literal: On jiwei day he visited Wuchuan garrison.
idiomatic: On jiwei day he visited Wuchuan garrison.

literal: On xinyou day he visited Fuming garrison.
idiomatic: On xinyou day he visited Fuming garrison.

literal: On jiazi day he visited Rouxuan garrison.
idiomatic: On jiazi day he visited Rouxuan garrison.

literal: On yichou day he returned south.
idiomatic: On yichou day he returned south.

literal: Wherever he passed he personally saw the aged, asked the people's hardships, and gave grain and silk to the poor, destitute, solitary, and old.
idiomatic: Wherever he passed he personally saw the aged, asked the people's hardships, and gave grain and silk to the poor, destitute, solitary, and old.

literal: On bingyin day an edict to the people of the Six Garrisons and Yuyi city: those eighty years and older without sons, grandsons, or brothers were to receive grain rations for life;
idiomatic: On bingyin day an edict to the people of the Six Garrisons and Yuyi city: those eighty years and older without sons, grandsons, or brothers were to receive grain rations for life;

literal: those seventy and older in poor households were each given ten hu of grain.
idiomatic: those seventy and older in poor households were each given ten hu of grain.

literal: Further, an edict to northerners of the garrison cities: those seventy and older and the disabled were to have their original offenses compared with the new statutes; where collective punishment applied, one person might return home, and one son was assigned to support him—only after death was he sent back to the frontier;
idiomatic: Further, an edict to northerners of the garrison cities: those seventy and older and the disabled were to have their original offenses compared with the new statutes; where collective punishment applied, one person might return home with one son assigned to support him—only after death was he sent back to the frontier;

literal: in other places, for such offenses, those eighty and older were all permitted to return.
idiomatic: in other places, for such offenses, those eighty and older were all permitted to return.

literal: On wuchen day the imperial carriage halted at Xuanhong Pool.
idiomatic: On wuchen day the imperial carriage halted at Xuanhong Pool.

literal: On gengwu day he visited Yonggu Tomb.
idiomatic: On gengwu day he visited Yonggu Tomb.

literal: On xinwei day he returned to Pingcheng palace.
idiomatic: On xinwei day he returned to Pingcheng palace.

literal: In the ninth month, on renshen day, the new moon, an edict said: "Triennial performance review is the ancient constant;
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renshen day, the new moon, an edict said, "Triennial performance review is the ancient constant;

literal: three reviews for promotion and demotion—to show ability or lack of it.
idiomatic: three reviews for promotion and demotion—to show ability or lack of it.

literal: If one now waits for three reviews before promotion and demotion, those who should be demoted are not delayed enough, and those who should advance are greatly slowed.
idiomatic: If one now waits for three reviews before promotion and demotion, those who should be demoted are not delayed enough, and those who should advance are greatly slowed.

literal: Therefore We now review once every three years, and on review immediately promote or demote, wishing that the dull not obstruct the able and talent not be blocked in low posts.
idiomatic: Therefore the emperor now reviews once every three years, and on review immediately promotes or demotes, wishing that the dull not obstruct the able and talent not be blocked in low posts.

literal: Each is to have his bureau review merit and rank them in three grades.
idiomatic: Each bureau was to review merit and rank officials in three grades.

literal: For rank six and below, the Masters of Writing will re-examine;
idiomatic: For rank six and below, the Masters of Writing would re-examine;

literal: for rank five and above, We will personally discuss their good and ill with the Three Dukes.
idiomatic: for rank five and above, the emperor would personally discuss their good and ill with the Three Dukes.

literal: The highest grade is to be transferred up; the lowest demoted; the middle grade keeps the original post.
idiomatic: The highest grade was to be transferred up; the lowest demoted; the middle grade kept the original post.

literal: " On renwu day the emperor attended the Audience Hall and personally promoted and demoted.
idiomatic: On renwu day the emperor attended the Audience Hall and personally promoted and demoted.

literal: On renchen day Prince of Yinping Yang Jiong came to court.
idiomatic: On renchen day Yang Jiong, Prince of Yinping, came to court.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on jiachen day, Grand Commandant, Prince of Dongyang Pi was made Grand Tutor.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiachen day, Pi, grand commandant and Prince of Dongyang, was made grand tutor.

literal: [8] On wushen day he personally announced at the Grand Temple and escorted the moved spirit tablets.
idiomatic: [8] On wushen day he personally announced at the Grand Temple and escorted the moved spirit tablets.

literal: On xinhai day the imperial carriage departed Pingcheng palace.
idiomatic: On xinhai day the imperial carriage departed Pingcheng palace.

literal: On renxu day he halted at Tang Lake in Zhongshan.
idiomatic: On renxu day he halted at Tang Lake in Zhongshan.

literal: On yichou day attendant ministers were sent separately to inquire into the people's hardships.
idiomatic: On yichou day attendant ministers were sent separately to inquire into the people's hardships.

literal: On jisi day he visited Xindu.
idiomatic: On jisi day he visited Xindu.

literal: On gengwu day an edict said: "We have lately heard that along the frontier the Man often raid and plunder, so that fathers and sons are torn apart and households divided—harmonious qi is lost and humaneness is wounded.
idiomatic: On gengwu day an edict said, "We have lately heard that along the frontier the Man often raid and plunder, so that fathers and sons are torn apart and households divided—harmonious qi is lost and humaneness is wounded.

literal: When We nurture all within the Four Seas and rear the myriad people, if it is thus, how will southerners know the court's virtue?
idiomatic: When We nurture all within the Four Seas and rear the myriad people, if it is thus, how will southerners know the court's virtue?

literal: Let Jing, Ying, and Eastern Jing be ordered to admonish the Man people not to commit violence."
idiomatic: Jing, Ying, and Eastern Jing were to be ordered to admonish the Man people not to commit violence."

literal: That month Xiao Luan deposed and killed his lord Xiao Zhaowen and usurped the throne.
idiomatic: That month Xiao Luan deposed and killed his lord Xiao Zhaowen and usurped the throne.

literal: In the eleventh month, on xinwei day, the new moon, an edict to the people of Ji and Ding provinces: those a hundred years and older were given acting county magistrate; ninety and older three ranks of nobility; eighty and older two ranks; seventy and older one rank;
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinwei day, the new moon, an edict to the people of Ji and Ding provinces: those a hundred years and older were given acting county magistrate; ninety and older three ranks of nobility; eighty and older two ranks; seventy and older one rank;

literal: widowers, orphans, and the solitary who could not support themselves were given grain and silk;
idiomatic: widowers, orphans, and the solitary who could not support themselves were given grain and silk;

literal: those of filial duty, integrity, and steadfastness, and those with civil or military talent sought, were all to be reported by name.
idiomatic: those of filial duty, integrity, and steadfastness, and those with civil or military talent sought, were all to be reported by name.

literal: On dingchou day the imperial carriage visited Ye.
idiomatic: On dingchou day the imperial carriage visited Ye.

literal: On jiashen day he passed the tomb of Bi Gan of Shang, grieved that loyalty had met punishment, personally composed a mourning text, and erected a stele with it carved.
idiomatic: On jiashen day he passed the tomb of Bi Gan of Shang, grieved that loyalty had met punishment, personally composed a mourning text, and erected a stele with it carved.

literal: On jichou day the imperial carriage reached Luoyang.
idiomatic: On jichou day the imperial carriage reached Luoyang.

literal: Xiao Luan's inspector of Yong Province Cao Hu held Xiangyang and asked to surrender.
idiomatic: Cao Hu, Xiao Luan's inspector of Yong Province, held Xiangyang and asked to surrender.

literal: In the twelfth month, on xinchou day, the new moon, Acting General Who Campaigns South Xue Zhendu was dispatched to supervise four generals out of Xiangyang; Grand General Liu Chang out of Yiyang; Inspector of Xu Province Yuan Yan out of Zhongli; General Who Pacifies the South Liu Zao out of Nanzheng.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinchou day, the new moon, Xue Zhendu, acting general who campaigns south, was dispatched to supervise four generals out of Xiangyang; Liu Chang, grand general, out of Yiyang; Yuan Yan, inspector of Xu province, out of Zhongli; Liu Zao, general who pacifies the south, out of Nanzheng.

literal: On renyin day the regulations for garments were reformed.
idiomatic: On renyin day the regulations for garments were reformed.

literal: On guimao day an edict proclaimed martial law within and without.
idiomatic: On guimao day an edict proclaimed martial law within and without.

literal: On wushen day favorable treatment was granted to households that had moved from Dai—rent and tax remitted for three years.
idiomatic: On wushen day favorable treatment was granted to households that had moved from Dai—rent and tax remitted for three years.

literal: On jiyou day an edict for kings, dukes, marquises, earls, viscounts, and barons with state fiefs: kings received half; dukes one-third; marquises and earls one-fourth; viscounts and barons one-fifth.
idiomatic: On jiyou day an edict for kings, dukes, marquises, earls, viscounts, and barons with state fiefs: kings received half; dukes one-third; marquises and earls one-fourth; viscounts and barons one-fifth.

literal: On xinhai day the imperial carriage campaigned south.
idiomatic: On xinhai day the imperial carriage campaigned south.

literal: On dingmao day an edict to the people of Ying and Yu provinces: those of full age a hundred years and older were given acting county magistrate; ninety and older three ranks of nobility; eighty and older two ranks; seventy and older one rank;
idiomatic: On dingmao day an edict to the people of Ying and Yu provinces: those of full age a hundred years and older were given acting county magistrate; ninety and older three ranks of nobility; eighty and older two ranks; seventy and older one rank;

literal: the solitary, orphaned, widowed, and aged who could not support themselves were given grain and silk;
idiomatic: the solitary, orphaned, widowed, and aged who could not support themselves were given grain and silk;

literal: people along the route had field rent remitted for one year;
idiomatic: people along the route had field rent remitted for one year;

literal: those of filial piety, brotherly duty, integrity, and righteousness, and those with civil or military talent sought, were all to be reported by name.
idiomatic: those of filial piety, brotherly duty, integrity, and righteousness, and those with civil or military talent sought, were all to be reported by name.

literal: On wuchen day the imperial carriage reached Xuanchi.
idiomatic: On wuchen day the imperial carriage reached Xuanchi.

literal: On jisi day an edict that male and female captives taken by armies at Shouyang, Zhongli, and Matou were all released and sent back south.
idiomatic: On jisi day an edict ordered that male and female captives taken by armies at Shouyang, Zhongli, and Matou were all released and sent back south.

literal: In the nineteenth year, spring, first month, on xinwei day, the new moon, he held court and feasted the officials at Xuanchi.
idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, spring, first month, on xinwei day, the new moon, he held court and feasted officials at Xuanchi.

literal: On guiyou day an edict forbade people north of the Huai to raid and plunder; offenders were judged by the great penalty.
idiomatic: On guiyou day an edict forbade people north of the Huai to raid and plunder; offenders were judged by the great penalty.

literal: On jiaxu day a proclamation rebuked Xiao Luan.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day a proclamation rebuked Xiao Luan.

literal: On bingzi day Wang Lang, marquis of Longyang county under Luan, came to surrender from Woyang.
idiomatic: On bingzi day Wang Lang, marquis of Longyang county under Luan, came to surrender from Woyang.

literal: On renwu day martial exercises were held west of the Ru River; the Six Armies were greatly rewarded.
idiomatic: On renwu day martial exercises were held west of the Ru River; the Six Armies were greatly rewarded.

literal: On bingshen day General Who Pacifies the South Wang Su repeatedly defeated Xiao Luan's generals and captured his inspector of Ning Province Dong Luan.
idiomatic: On bingshen day Wang Su, general who pacifies the south, repeatedly defeated Xiao Luan's generals and captured Dong Luan, his inspector of Ning province.

literal: On jihai day the imperial carriage crossed the Huai.
idiomatic: On jihai day the imperial carriage crossed the Huai.

literal: In the second month, on jiachen day, he visited Bagong Mountain.
idiomatic: In the second month, on jiachen day, he visited Bagong Mountain.

literal: On the road rain was heavy; an edict removed the carriage canopy;
idiomatic: On the road rain was heavy; an edict removed the carriage canopy;

literal: wherever sick soldiers were seen, he personally showed compassion.
idiomatic: wherever sick soldiers were seen, he personally showed compassion.

literal: On wushen day the imperial carriage toured east along the Huai; the people were all secure in their homes, and rent grain lined the road.
idiomatic: On wushen day the imperial carriage toured east along the Huai; the people were all secure in their homes, and rent grain lined the road.

literal: On renzi day Goryeo sent envoys presenting tribute.
idiomatic: On renzi day Goryeo sent envoys presenting tribute.

literal: On bingchen day the imperial carriage reached Zhongli.
idiomatic: On bingchen day the imperial carriage reached Zhongli.

literal: On wuwu day soldiers captured three thousand of Xiao Luan's troops. The emperor said: "To the ruler they are subjects—what crime have the people?"
idiomatic: On wuwu day soldiers captured three thousand of Xiao Luan's troops. The emperor said, "To the ruler they are subjects—what crime have the people?"

literal: " They were then released to return home.
idiomatic: They were then released to return home.

literal: On xinyou day the imperial carriage departed Zhongli and was about to approach the Yangzi.
idiomatic: On xinyou day the imperial carriage departed Zhongli and was about to approach the Yangzi.

literal: Minister of Works Feng Dan died.
idiomatic: Minister of Works Feng Dan died.

literal: On renxu day an edict then ordered withdrawal of the army.
idiomatic: On renxu day an edict then ordered withdrawal of the army.

literal: On dingmao day envoys were sent to the riverbank to enumerate Xiao Luan's crimes in killing his lord and usurping the throne.
idiomatic: On dingmao day envoys were sent to the riverbank to enumerate Xiao Luan's crimes in killing his lord and usurping the throne.

literal: In the third month, on wuyin day, he visited Shaoyang.
idiomatic: In the third month, on wuyin day, he visited Shaoyang.

literal: On wuzi day Grand Tutor Feng Xi died.
idiomatic: On wuzi day Feng Xi, grand tutor, died.

literal: On yiwei day he visited Xiapi.
idiomatic: On yiwei day he visited Xiapi.

literal: The state of Dengzhi sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: The state of Dengzhi sent envoys with tribute.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, on gengzi day, the imperial carriage visited Pengcheng.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on gengzi day, the imperial carriage visited Pengcheng.

literal: On xinchou day the emperor held mourning for Grand Tutor Feng Xi at the traveling residence.
idiomatic: On xinchou day the emperor held mourning for Feng Xi, grand tutor, at the traveling residence.

literal: On dingwei day a partial amnesty in Xu and Yu provinces; transport laborers had rent and tax remitted for three years.
idiomatic: On dingwei day a partial amnesty was proclaimed in Xu and Yu provinces; transport laborers had rent and tax remitted for three years.

literal: On xinhai day an edict granted acting county magistrate to those a hundred years and older, three ranks of nobility to ninety and older, two ranks to eighty and older, one rank to seventy and older;
idiomatic: On xinhai day an edict granted acting county magistrate to those a hundred years and older, three ranks of nobility to ninety and older, two ranks to eighty and older, one rank to seventy and older;

literal: the solitary, orphaned, aged, and sick who could not support themselves were given grain and silk;
idiomatic: the solitary, orphaned, aged, and sick who could not support themselves were given grain and silk;

literal: those whose virtue was marked in hill and garden were all to be reported by name;
idiomatic: those whose virtue was marked in hill and garden were all to be reported by name;

literal: people of Xiao Luan who submitted were given fifteen years' remission.
idiomatic: people of Xiao Luan who submitted were given fifteen years' remission.

literal: On guichou day he visited Xiao Pei and sent envoys to sacrifice to the temple of Han Gaozu with the great offering.
idiomatic: On guichou day he visited Xiao Pei and sent envoys to sacrifice to the temple of Han Gaozu with the great offering.

literal: On jiwei day he traveled to Xiaqiu and sent envoys to sacrifice to Mount Tai with the great offering.
idiomatic: On jiwei day he traveled to Xiaqiu and sent envoys to sacrifice to Mount Tai with the great offering.

literal: An edict raised rank one grade for martial guard officers.
idiomatic: An edict raised rank one grade for martial guard officers.

literal: On gengshen day he traveled to Lu city and personally sacrificed at the temple of Confucius.
idiomatic: On gengshen day he traveled to Lu city and personally sacrificed at the temple of Confucius.

literal: On xinyou day an edict appointed four men of the Kong clan and two of the Yan clan to office.
idiomatic: On xinyou day an edict appointed four men of the Kong clan and two of the Yan clan to office.

literal: An edict ordered the inspector of Yan Province to recommend within the province men of talent fit for army and state or for prefect and magistrate governance, all to be reported by name.
idiomatic: An edict ordered the inspector of Yan province to recommend men of talent within the province fit for army and state or for prefect and magistrate governance, all to be reported by name.

literal: Further, an edict granted nobility ranks and grain and silk to the people of Yan Province as in Xu Province.
idiomatic: Further, an edict granted nobility ranks and grain and silk to the people of Yan province as in Xu province.

literal: Further, an edict chose one man of the Kong clan as Marquis Who Reveres the Sage, fief of a hundred households, to maintain sacrifice to Confucius.
idiomatic: Further, an edict chose one man of the Kong clan as Marquis Who Reveres the Sage, fief of a hundred households, to maintain sacrifice to Confucius.

literal: Further, an edict raised for Confucius a garden of cypress in Yan Province, repaired the mound, and rebuilt the stele to praise sage virtue.
idiomatic: Further, an edict raised for Confucius a garden of cypress in Yan province, repaired the mound, and rebuilt the stele to praise sage virtue.

literal: On wuchen day he traveled to Que'ao.
idiomatic: On wuchen day he traveled to Que'ao.

literal: The Taihe Temple was completed.
idiomatic: The Taihe Temple was completed.

literal: In the fifth month, on jisi day, Prince of Chengyang Luan lost at Zheyang and was reduced to Prince of Dingxiang county.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jisi day, Luan, Prince of Chengyang, lost at Zheyang and was reduced to Prince of Dingxiang county.

literal: Prince of Guangchuan Xie died.
idiomatic: Prince of Guangchuan Xie died.

literal: On gengwu day the spirit tablet of Empress Feng, consort of Emperor Wencheng, was moved to Taihe Temple.
idiomatic: On gengwu day the spirit tablet of Empress Feng, consort of Emperor Wencheng, was moved to Taihe Temple.

literal: On jiaxu day he traveled to Huatai.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day he traveled to Huatai.

literal: On bingzi day he halted at Shiji.
idiomatic: On bingzi day he halted at Shiji.

literal: On gengchen day the crown prince attended at Pingtao city.
idiomatic: On gengchen day the crown prince attended at Pingtao city.

literal: Goryeo and Tuyuhun each sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: Goryeo and Tuyuhun each sent envoys with tribute.
